name: Stop
meaning: You must come to a complete halt at this point.
action: Stop fully, look both ways, and move only when the road is clear.

name: Give Way
meaning: Vehicles on the main road have priority over you.
action: Slow down and let traffic on the main road pass before you enter.

name: No Entry
meaning: Vehicles are not allowed to enter this road from this side.
action: Do not enter. Take another route.

name: No Parking
meaning: You may not leave your vehicle parked here.
action: Find a designated parking area nearby.

name: No Stopping
meaning: Vehicles may not stop here, even for a short time.
action: Keep moving and do not halt, not even to pick up or drop off people.

name: No U-Turn
meaning: You may not turn your vehicle around to go back the way you came.
action: Continue ahead and find a place where a U-turn is allowed.

name: No Right Turn
meaning: Turning right is not allowed here.
action: Go straight or use a different route to reach your destination.

name: No Left Turn
meaning: Turning left is not allowed here.
action: Go straight or use a different route to reach your destination.

name: No Overtaking
meaning: You may not pass the vehicle in front of you on this stretch of road.
action: Stay behind the vehicle ahead until the sign ends.

name: No Honking (Silence Zone)
meaning: Blowing the horn is not allowed in this area. It is usually near a hospital or school.
action: Do not use your horn.

name: Speed Limit
meaning: The number on the sign is the highest speed, in kilometres per hour, that you may drive.
action: Keep your speed at or below the number shown on the sign.

name: Pedestrians Prohibited
meaning: People on foot are not allowed on this road.
action: If you are walking, use another path or a footpath.

name: School Ahead
meaning: There is a school close by and children may be crossing or playing near the road.
action: Slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: People may be crossing the road ahead.
action: Slow down and let people cross safely.

name: Speed Breaker Ahead
meaning: There is a raised bump on the road ahead.
action: Slow down before the bump.

name: Men at Work
meaning: There are workers or road repairs ahead.
action: Slow down, follow the diversions, and watch for workers.

name: Sharp Curve Ahead
meaning: The road bends sharply ahead.
action: Slow down and keep to your side of the road.

name: Slippery Road
meaning: The road surface may be slippery, especially when wet.
action: Drive slowly and avoid sudden braking.

name: Narrow Bridge
meaning: The bridge ahead is narrower than the road.
action: Slow down and give way to oncoming traffic if needed.

name: Railway Level Crossing
meaning: A railway line crosses the road ahead.
action: Slow down, look and listen for trains, and never cross when the gate is closed.

name: Cattle Crossing
meaning: Animals may be on or crossing the road ahead.
action: Slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Falling Rocks
meaning: Rocks may fall onto the road ahead. This is common on hill roads.
action: Drive carefully and do not stop under the slope.

name: Hospital
meaning: A hospital is nearby.
action: Keep the road clear for ambulances and avoid making noise.

name: First Aid Post
meaning: Basic medical help is available here.
action: Go here for emergency first aid.

name: Petrol Pump
meaning: You can buy fuel for your vehicle nearby.
action: Follow the sign to refuel.

name: Parking
meaning: You may park your vehicle here.
action: Park inside the marked spaces.

name: Exit
meaning: This is the way out of the building or area.
action: Use this way to leave. Keep the path clear.
